name: Centricide: The Visual Novel
source:
Based on the semi-popular web series of the same name, Centricide: The Visual Novel seeks to continue the legacy and act as a pseudo-anarcho-neo-sequel.

Summary: Taking place inside a college student's stress dream, you enter the world of the political compass. Choose to either solve the mystery as to why you're still such a spineless piece of shit, or ignore that entirely and focus on getting on your favorite extremist's good side.
[From [url=https://junipvelt.itch.io/centricidevn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《杀戮中心：视觉小说》改编自半流行的同名网络连续剧，旨在延续这一传统，并充当伪无政府主义新续集。

简介：故事发生在一名大学生的压力梦中，你进入了政治罗盘的世界。选择要么解开为什么你仍然是一个如此没有骨气的废物的谜团，要么完全忽略它并专注于你最喜欢的极端分子的好的一面。
[来自[url=https://junipvelt.itch.io/centricidevn]Itch.io[/url]]
